identification.interpretation: Qualcomm PBL contents linked for zero; silicon ROM versus a mirror or alias is not independently proven by these reads.

acquisition.method: Read-only /dev/mem mmap and aligned volatile 32-bit loads, through a RAM-booted diagnostic Pocketboot kernel.
acquisition.repeat_result: Byte-identical complete reads in one diagnostic boot; independent word and page prefixes also agree.
acquisition.restoration: Persistent BOOT readback remained byte-identical. Device returned to its original Pocketboot kernel.
